name: caption-highlight
title: Highlight
description: Reel captions on a black rounded plate: groups of up to three words in one upper-case line at one size, a red accent bar sweeping in behind each word as it is spoken. All words and timings come in one variable; mount over the whole frame for the speech.

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Every caption word with its timing, in order: word|start|end separated by ; (seconds from mount start, e.g. Такой|0.20|0.48;монтаж|0.48|0.90). Build it from transcript.json words.
